svg.title: Three graphs for x from 0 to 360 degrees, each cut by a dashed horizontal line. Top: y equals sin x and the line y equals 0.8 cross twice, at a, which is about 53 degrees, and at 180 degrees minus a, about 127 degrees, mirror images either side of 90 degrees. Middle: y equals cos x and the line y equals 0.4 cross at a, about 66 degrees, and at 360 degrees minus a, about 294 degrees, mirror images either side of 180 degrees. Bottom: y equals tan x and the line y equals 2 cross at a, about 63 degrees, and at 180 degrees plus a, about 243 degrees, one in each rising piece.
